en.headline: North Point water main burst disrupts supply on Fuk Yan Road
en.dek: A 250 mm fresh-water main burst at the junction of King Wah Road and Fuk Yan Road early Friday, cutting supply to nearby residences and shops; most service was restored by late morning with repairs continuing.
body: Police received a report at about 7.27 am on Friday of a water main burst at the junction of King Wah Road and Fuk Yan Road in North Point. The Water Supplies Department confirmed the pipe was a 250 mm diameter fresh-water main serving users along Fuk Yan Road, King Wah Road and Wang On Road.

After isolating the main, flooding stopped. Temporary water was provided by two water trucks and four tanks, and the department’s emergency team delivered bottled water to those in need. Care Teams assisted on site. Parts of Fuk Yan Road were closed to traffic for the repair works.

By around 11 am most affected users had supply restored after network adjustments; only residents of one estate remained without full service. The department said it aimed to complete repairs and restore that remaining supply by 10 pm, subject to the condition of the damaged pipe.

zh.headline: 北角福蔭道食水管爆裂 附近一度停水
zh.dek: 周五早上京華道與福蔭道交界一條250毫米食水管爆裂，附近住宅及食肆食水供應受影響，大部分用戶上午已恢復，搶修仍在進行。
body: 警方周五早上約7時27分接報，北角京華道與福蔭道交界有水管爆裂。水務署確認涉事為一條直徑250毫米的食水供水管，負責供應福蔭道、京華道及宏安道一帶用戶。
關上水掣後現場停止湧水。署方派出兩架水車及四個水箱提供臨時食水，供水特攻隊向有需要用戶送上樽裝水，關愛隊亦在場協助。福蔭道部分行車線須暫時封閉以配合維修。
經調配供水後，除一個屋苑外，其餘受影響用戶食水供應已於上午11時左右恢復正常。署方表示正繼續搶修，視乎水管損壞情況，爭取晚上10時前全面恢復該屋苑供水。
